type.description: This is the type of the key. Most likely, this is "service_account".

projectId.description: This is the ID of the Google Cloud project associated with this key.

privateKeyId.description: This is the unique identifier for the private key.

privateKey.description:
This is the private key in PEM format.

Note: This is not returned in the API.

clientEmail.description: This is the email address associated with the service account.

clientId.description: This is the unique identifier for the client.

authUri.description: This is the URI for the auth provider's authorization endpoint.

tokenUri.description: This is the URI for the auth provider's token endpoint.

authProviderX509CertUrl.description: This is the URL of the public x509 certificate for the auth provider.

clientX509CertUrl.description: This is the URL of the public x509 certificate for the client.

universeDomain.description: This is the domain associated with the universe this service account belongs to.
